_comment: Registry connector name -> the plugin spec name the connector reports at runtime. Pipelines refer to plugins by spec name, so two listed connectors must never share one. A value is either the spec name, read from specification.name in connector.yaml at each release tag, or {"spec": name, "specSource": path} for connectors that define the spec in Go (path is relative to the repository root at the tag). validate_entries.py checks completeness and uniqueness; check_spec_names.py fetches the source at every listed tag and checks the value.
